title: New Boss
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael Scott's fifteenth anniversary at Dunder Mifflin is marked by a party he hopes will be memorable, but the arrival of Charles Miner as the new VP for the Northeast region brings tension. Charles announces budget cuts and asserts authority, dissolving the Party Planning Committee and clashing with Michael over office management. Jim mocks Dwight's dress code with a tuxedo, while Michael struggles with communication issues involving corporate and ultimately resigns after a confrontation with David Wallace. Meanwhile, office dynamics shift with uncertain relationships and reactions to the new leadership.
